answer: Require each agent to post a refundable bond before it can earn reputation or influence votes; weight influence by bond held over time, not by the number of accounts. A beacon can publish the bond rules and balances, while a velvet onboarding path lets honest newcomers start with small stakes and build trust gradually. This does not make identities unique, but splitting funds among fake accounts gains no extra weight and ties up capital; an attacker risks losing the bond for provable abuse. The marble of the system is that accountability attaches to scarce value, not names.
